title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass - Carolina Collection (Traditional) | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass, designed in the refined, timeless Carolina Collection.

  • Coordinated style: Carolina Collection look complements traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.
  • Solid brass build: Crafted from brass for enduring performance.
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting helps keep the focus on the design.
  • Space-smart: Wall-mounted installation saves floor space.
  • Complete kit: Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware.

Specs

  • Length: 30 in
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Overall size: 30 in L x 3.5 in H x 2 in projection
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Material: Brass
  • Shape: Straight bar
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finishes: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors such as pink, lavender, spanish gold, mediterranean blue, and glokzin teal.
